---

  html_document:
    toc: true

    theme: flatly
    df_print: paged
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    latex_engine: xelatex
params:
  datasets: NULL
  active_dataset: NULL
  multi_integration: NULL
  sections: NULL
  fig_width: 9
  fig_height: 7
  report_title: "Analyse Spatiale"
  report_subtitle: ""

  interactive: TRUE

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = params$fig_width %||% 9, fig.height = params$fig_height %||% 7,
                      out.width = "100%")
sections <- params$sections %||% character(0)

# i18n Phase 5 : traduction des chaines du rapport. Les cles (chaines FR)
# sont resolues COTE SERVEUR au moment du clic (mod_spatial_report.R) et
# injectees via params$i18n_strings ; a defaut, la cle FR s'affiche telle
# quelle (fallback gracieux). tr_fmt() interpolate les placeholders {name}.
tr <- function(key) {
  s <- params$i18n_strings
  if (is.null(s)) return(key)
  vapply(key, function(k) if (k %in% names(s)) s[[k]] else k, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
tr_fmt <- function(template, ...) {
  vals <- list(...)
  for (nm in names(vals)) {
    template <- gsub(paste0("{", nm, "}"), format(vals[[nm]]), template, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  template
}

# Step-3.7-style helper (sc_report_template.Rmd) reused verbatim: wrapping a
# raw htmlwidget (plotly) inside a results='asis'-adjacent flow needs
# htmltools::tagList() for correct JS/CSS dependency injection.
render_plot <- function(p, allow_interactive = TRUE) {
  if (allow_interactive && isTRUE(params$interactive) && knitr::is_html_output() &&
      requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(htmltools::tagList(plotly::ggplotly(p)))
  }
  p
}

# Spatial-map specific helper: builds plotly DIRECTLY (not via ggplotly())
# when interactive, because scattermore::geom_scattermore() -- used by
# render_spatial_static_map(), R/utils_spatial_export.R, already sourced
# into globalenv() by app.R -- produces a raster grob that plotly::ggplotly()
# cannot faithfully convert (known scattermore/plotly incompatibility).
# Falls back to render_spatial_static_map() for PDF / non-interactive HTML,
# where that raster approach is exactly the right (fast, large-N-safe) tool.
render_plot_spatial <- function(df, title = NULL, histology = NULL) {
  df <- df[stats::complete.cases(df[, c("x", "y")]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  .hist_img <- NULL
  if (!is.null(histology) && !is.null(histology$data_uri) &&
      nzchar(histology$data_uri) && !is.null(histology$bounds)) {
    .hb <- histology$bounds
    .hist_img <- list(
      source = histology$data_uri, xref = "x", yref = "y",
      x = .hb$x[1L], y = -.hb$y[2L],
      sizex = .hb$x[2L] - .hb$x[1L], sizey = .hb$y[2L] - .hb$y[1L],
      xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom", sizing = "stretch",
      opacity = 0.7, layer = "below"
    )
  }

  interactive_ok <- isTRUE(params$interactive) && knitr::is_html_output() &&
    requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)

  if (interactive_ok) {
    df_i <- df
    if (nrow(df_i) > 20000) {
      set.seed(1)
      df_i <- df_i[sample.int(nrow(df_i), 20000), , drop = FALSE]
    }
    if (is.numeric(df_i$value)) {
      p <- plotly::plot_ly(df_i, x = ~x, y = ~-y, type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
                           marker = list(color = ~value, colorscale = "Viridis", size = 4, showscale = TRUE),
                           text = ~paste0("Valeur: ", round(value, 3)), hoverinfo = "text")
    } else {
      p <- plotly::plot_ly(df_i, x = ~x, y = ~-y, color = ~value, type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
                           marker = list(size = 4), text = ~paste0("Valeur: ", value), hoverinfo = "text")
    }
    .xr <- if (!is.null(.hist_img)) range(c(range(df$x), .hb$x)) else NULL
    .yr <- if (!is.null(.hist_img)) range(c(range(-df$y), -.hb$y)) else NULL
    p <- plotly::layout(p, title = title,
                        images = if (!is.null(.hist_img)) list(.hist_img) else list(),
                        xaxis = list(title = "", zeroline = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE, range = .xr),
                        yaxis = list(title = "", zeroline = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE, scaleanchor = "x", range = .yr))
    return(htmltools::tagList(p))
  }
  print(render_spatial_static_map(df, title = title, histology = histology))
}
```

```{r overview_table_build, eval="overview" %in% sections}
ov <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(params$datasets), function(nm) {
  d <- params$datasets[[nm]]
  data.frame(
    `Echantillon` = nm, `Technologie` = d$technology %||% "?",
    `Elements (total)` = format(d$n_total %||% NA, big.mark = ","),
    `Sketch (RAM)` = format(length(d$sketch_ids), big.mark = ","),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
colnames(ov) <- tr(c("Echantillon", "Technologie", "Elements (total)", "Sketch (RAM)"))
```
```{r overview_table_html, eval="overview" %in% sections && knitr::is_html_output()}
DT::datatable(ov, options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "t"), rownames = FALSE)
```
```{r overview_table_pdf, eval="overview" %in% sections && !knitr::is_html_output()}
knitr::kable(ov)
```

# `r tr("Par echantillon")`

```{r dataset_loop, results='asis'}
# Canonical R Markdown "child-per-item" loop (knitr::knit_child): each
# iteration binds ds/ds_name into ITS OWN function-execution environment,
# then renders spatial_report_dataset_child.Rmd with envir = that
# environment -- the child inherits ds/ds_name via normal lexical lookup,
# plus everything from THIS document's setup chunk (params, render_plot(),
# render_plot_spatial(), %||%, tr(), tr_fmt()) via the parent-environment
# chain.
child_path <- "spatial_report_dataset_child.Rmd"
res <- lapply(names(params$datasets), function(nm) {
  ds <- params$datasets[[nm]]
  ds_name <- nm
  knitr::knit_child(child_path, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
})
cat(unlist(res), sep = "\n")
```
